items.title: N-able N-Central hotfix addresses critical RCE flaw (CVE-2026-86218)
items.summary: N-able released an emergency hotfix for a critical remote code execution vulnerability in N-Central affecting on-prem instances.

items.title: F5 patches critical BIG-IP APM zero-day under active exploitation
items.summary: CVE-2026-94127 (CVSS 9.3) is a heap-based buffer overflow in BIG-IP APM OAuth setups. CISA added it to the KEV catalog with a Friday patch deadline for federal agencies.

items.title: GitLab critical patch release fixes 11 flaws, two CVSS 9.9 RCEs
items.summary: CVE-2026-89078 and CVE-2026-93577 allow authenticated RCE via malformed regex. Self-managed admins urged to upgrade to 19.4.1, 19.3.3, or 19.2.7 immediately.

items.title: September 2026 Patch Tuesday: fixes for two zero-days among ~1,000 updates
items.summary: Microsoft's September Patch Tuesday fixed two zero-day flaws plus hundreds of other vulnerabilities across Windows and services.

items.title: Check Point patches critical pre-auth root RCE in management servers
items.summary: CVE-2026-91843 (CVSS 9.8) is a stack overflow in the Security Management Server login parser. Fifth management-plane auth bypass at Check Point since July.
